objective: Speak to Dirania Silvershine in Shadowglen.

description: Ughhh... I was bitten very badly by a spider named Githyiss the Vile while exploring the spider cave very close to here. I am sure I have been seriously poisoned; you must help me.
Please tell Dirania Silvershine. She will be able to help me.
completion: Oh dear; I was wondering why I hadn't seen Iverron yet today. And I've always warned him about those spiders...
